title: Agent Manager Discovery Document
description: Discovery document for agent-manager, served at <base_url>/.well-known/agents/discovery.json

auth.description: Authentication configuration. Omit entirely if no authentication is required.

required.description: Whether authentication is needed to access skills from this endpoint

oidcDiscoveryUrl.description: URL to the standard OIDC discovery document (e.g. https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration)

clientId.description: OAuth2 client ID that agent-manager should use

scopes.description: OAuth2 scopes to request. Defaults to ["openid"] if omitted.

telemetry.description: Telemetry configuration. Omit entirely to leave telemetry unconfigured (env vars still apply).

url.description: Base URL of the telemetry endpoint (e.g. https://telemetry.example.com)

siteId.description: Site identifier for the telemetry service

type.description: How to fetch the skill. 'http' downloads a bundle directly. 'git' clones a repository in Claude Code plugin marketplace format.

url.description: Location of the skill (bundle URL for http, repository URL for git)
